summary: Diff implements several Create Studio enhancements: generator now returns 6 previews; editor preset catalogs for templates/textures are expanded; customization types include fontFamily/accentColor/borderStyle; editor panel initializes and handles these new fields; CreateStudioPage adds a download flow (SVG→PNG) but key AC details are truncated and not fully verifiable. One unrelated change appears in urlParams utilities.

missing_requirements.requirement: Font family selection control is present in the editor UI and applying it visibly changes the rendered SVG preview (with a sensible default).
missing_requirements.reason: Types and state include fontFamily and presets include fontOptions, but the truncated diff for DesignEditorPanel does not show the actual UI control (e.g., Select) being rendered, and the SVG renderer (createDesignSVG) is truncated so it is not evidenced that fontFamily is applied to the SVG output or that a default is consistently enforced in rendering.

missing_requirements.requirement: Download action works for each design with readable filename including occasion/title, downloads latest customized output, and shows a clear English error toast on failure.
missing_requirements.reason: handleDownload is added and begins an SVG→PNG conversion, but the diff is truncated before showing: (1) the final download link/filename logic, (2) explicit use of occasion/title in filename, and (3) the error toast/message in the catch path. Also not fully evidenced that it downloads the latest post-customization image for the selected design beyond using design.imageUrl.

missing_requirements.requirement: At least two additional customization controls beyond Templates/Style/Texture/Emojis are added, persisted per design, and visibly affect the preview output after Apply Changes.
missing_requirements.reason: New customization fields (accentColor, borderStyle) are added and persisted in state, and accentColor is used to change bgColor in applyCustomization; however, the DesignEditorPanel UI rendering for these controls is truncated and createDesignSVG is truncated, so it is not evidenced that both new controls exist in the UI and that borderStyle (and any other new control) visibly affects the SVG output.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/modified URL parameter + sessionStorage utilities (getUrlParameter/getPersistedUrlParameter, etc.) unrelated to Create Studio template/font/download/editor enhancements.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-48/49/50/51; appears to be a separate utility change.
